idinfo.native: Microsoft Windows XP Version 5.1 (Build 2600) Service Pack 2; ESRI ArcCatalog 9.2.4.1420

descript.abstract: This point layer contains all building centroid points within the City of Cambridge and addresses associated with each building from the Master Address database. For buildings with more than one address, address points are stacked on top of one another at the centroid point. Buildings with no associated address (such as garages, sheds, and warehouses) have address points at their centroid but contain null addresses.
descript.purpose: This layer was created for address geocoding and general mapping purposes, both for internal and external use.

idinfo.useconst: This layer does not represent an officially exhaustive list of addresses within Cambridge, and is to be used for reference purposes only.

dataIdInfo.envirDesc: Microsoft Windows XP Version 5.1 (Build 2600) Service Pack 2; ESRI ArcCatalog 9.2.4.1420

metainfo.metstdn: FGDC Content Standards for Digital Geospatial Metadata

stdorder.ordering: Data requests may be made by visiting this website: http://www.cambridgema.gov/gis/datasales.cfm

altsys.altenc: Explicit elevation coordinate included with horizontal coordinates

attr.attrdef: Tree district (same as CDD Neighborhood number)
Street ID - relates to Centerline layer street ID
Mailing address designation (1=mailing address, 0=not a mailing address)
Unique building ID - relates to Buildings layer and Master Address database
Point of interest name for the address
Elevation above sea level, in feet, of the roofline
Elevation above sea level, in feet, of the highest point of the building
Estimated height (in feet) from the ground to the highest point of the building
Estimated height (in feet) from the ground to the building roofline
Estimated elevation above sea level (in feet) of the ground
X coordinate of the building centroid
Y coordinate of the building centroid
Full address in all caps for geocoding purposes

attrdomv.udom: Sequential unique whole numbers that are automatically generated.

attracc.attraccr: Original buildings data from the flyover were compiled using photogrammetric methods to meet ASPRS Class 1 accuracy standards for 1" = 100' scale mapping. The Buildings layer has been manually updated with major footprint changes through 2007 from georeferenced building plans. Master addresses compiled from ECC address list, Post Office address list, and field verified by Cambridge GIS in 2003-2004. Newer address changes made from CRS requests via DPW and ECC, and field verified by Cambridge GIS in 2007.
